description: Read a public RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 or Atom feed and get the feed title, link and description plus its newest items: title, link, date (ISO 8601), short plain-text summary, author and id. Up to 50 items, feeds up to 2 MB. Lenient with real-world feeds; a page that is not a feed returns 422, uncharged. Use to follow news, blogs, release notes or podcasts without scraping pages. Costs $0.002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
